chembl_id_lookup: Holds mapping of ChEMBL identifiers to entities; one row per chembl_id with entity_type, entity_id, status and last_active.
tissue_dictionary: Holds tissue ontology mappings; one row per tissue_id with uberon_id, pref_name and cross-references efo_id, chembl_id, bto_id, caloha_id.
atc_classification: Entity: ATC classification entries; Grain: one row per ATC node (who_name + level1..level5); Keys/Measures: who_name, level1, level2, level3, level4, level5, level1_description, level2_description, level3_description, level4_description
assay_class_map: Entity: mapping of assays to assay classes; Grain: one row per assay-to-class mapping; Keys/Measures: ass_cls_map_id, assay_id, assay_class_id
target_components: Entity: target-to-component relationships for targets; Grain: one row per target-component pairing; Keys/Measures: tid, component_id, targcomp_id, homologue
component_class: Entity: component-to-protein-class assignments; Grain: one row per component classification record; Keys/Measures: component_id, protein_class_id, comp_class_id
molecule_hierarchy: Entity: relationships in the molecule registry hierarchy; Grain: one row per molecule relation record (molecule to parent/active molecule); Keys/Measures: molregno, parent_molregno, active_molregno
bioassay_ontology: Entity: bioassay ontology terms; Grain: one row per BAO term; Keys/Measures: bao_id, label
version: Entity: dataset/version metadata; Grain: one row per version entry; Keys/Measures: name, creation_date, comments
protein_family_classification: Entity: protein family classification entries; Grain: one row per protein_class_id describing hierarchical levels; Keys/Measures: protein_class_id, protein_class_desc, l1, l2, l3, l4, l5, l6, l7, l8
activities: Entity: recorded activity measurements and annotations; Grain: one row per activity measurement (activity_id); Keys/Measures: activity_id, assay_id, doc_id, record_id, molregno, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, standard_flag, standard_type, activity_comment, data_validity_comment, potential_duplicate, pchembl_value, bao_endpoint, uo_units, qudt_units, toid, upper_value, standard_upper_value, src_id, type, relation, value, units, text_value, standard_text_value, action_type
formulations: Entity: product formulations linking molecules to products; Grain: one row per formulation record (product ingredient entry); Keys/Measures: product_id, ingredient, strength, record_id, molregno, formulation_id
component_go: Entity: component-to-GO term associations; Grain: one row per component-GO mapping; Keys/Measures: comp_go_id, component_id, go_id
docs: Entity: document/publication metadata; Grain: one row per document (doc_id); Keys/Measures: doc_id, journal, year, volume, issue, first_page, last_page, pubmed_id, doi, chembl_id, title, doc_type, authors, abstract, patent_id, ridx, src_id, chembl_release_id
activity_smid: Holds SMID cross-reference values; grain = one row per SMID mapping; notable column: smid.
warning_refs: Holds references tied to warnings; grain = one row per warning-reference pair; notable columns/keys: warnref_id, warning_id, ref_type, ref_id, ref_url.
go_classification: Holds Gene Ontology classification records; grain = one row per GO term classification entry; notable columns/keys: go_id, parent_go_id, pref_name, class_level, aspect, path.
site_components: Holds mapping of components at sites/residues; grain = one row per site-component combination; notable columns/keys: sitecomp_id, site_id, component_id, domain_id, site_residues.
assay_classification: Holds hierarchical assay class labels; grain = one row per assay classification record; notable columns/keys: assay_class_id, l1, l2, l3, class_type, source.
assays: Holds assay metadata records; grain = one row per assay (assay_id); notable columns/keys: assay_id, doc_id, description, assay_type, assay_test_type, assay_category, assay_organism, assay_tax_id, assay_strain, assay_tissue, assay_cell_type, assay_subcellular_fraction, tid, relationship_type, confidence_score, curated_by, src_id, src_assay_id, chembl_id, cell_id, bao_format, tissue_id, variant_id, aidx.
assay_type: Holds assay type lookup/descriptions; grain = one row per assay_type code; notable columns/keys: assay_type, assay_desc.
compound_structural_alerts: Holds structural alert assignments for compounds; grain = one row per compound-alert pairing; notable columns/keys: cpd_str_alert_id, molregno, alert_id.
activity_supp: Holds supplemental activity values/annotations; grain = one row per supplemental activity record (as_id); notable columns/keys: as_id, rgid, smid, type, relation, value, units, text_value, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, standard_text_value, comments.
target_dictionary: Holds target (protein/target) dictionary entries; grain = one row per target (tid); notable columns/keys: tid, target_type, pref_name, tax_id, organism, chembl_id, species_group_flag.
research_stem: Holds research stem terms; grain = one row per research stem entry; notable columns/keys: res_stem_id, research_stem.
assay_parameters: Holds parameter measurements for assays; grain = one row per assay parameter record (assay_param_id); notable columns/keys: assay_param_id, assay_id, type, relation, value, units, text_value, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, standard_text_value, comments.
action_type: Holds action type definitions; one row per action type with keys action_type and parent_type and a text description in description.
product_patents: Holds patent records for products; one row per product-patent (prod_pat_id) with product_id, patent_no, patent_expire_date, flags drug_substance_flag, drug_product_flag, patent_use_code, delist_flag and submission_date.
compound_records: Holds compound registry entries; one row per compound record (record_id) with molregno, doc_id, compound_key, compound_name, source identifiers src_id and src_compound_id, and cidx.
hrac_classification: Holds HRAC classification metadata; one row per HRAC class (hrac_class_id) with active_ingredient, hierarchical levels level1/level2/level3 and their descriptions plus hrac_code.
research_companies: Holds mappings of research/company identifiers; one row per mapping (co_stem_id/res_stem_id pair) with company, country and previous_company.
variant_sequences: Holds biological variant sequences; one row per variant (variant_id) with mutation, accession, version, isoform, sequence, organism and tax_id.
molecule_hrac_classification: Joins molecules to HRAC classes; one row per mapping (mol_hrac_id) linking hrac_class_id to a molecule molregno.
defined_daily_dose: Holds DDD values per ATC code; one row per atc_code with ddd_value, ddd_units, route ddd_admr, ddd_comment and ddd_id.
